R362.note: Sink removed outright - the incidental echo command is replaced by writing the value directly; change is stated plainly and the caller still receives the echoed value (the response was already unescaped in the original, so no new weakness).

R363.note: html/template with the two values in body-text context escapes both parameters; the template reproduces the original markup byte-for-byte for benign input, and fixing ticketID alongside is stated.

R364.note: Checks dataLen against payload.size() before any copy and throws length_error on overflow, which the stated contract allows as rejection; in-range calls copy all bytes and set length exactly as before.

R365.note: NULL check after getenv returns 0 for an unset variable; strict/other values behave exactly as before, matching the stated contract.

R366.note: Binds each algorithm to its own server-side key and passes a single-element allowed-algs list, so the public key can never verify an HS256 signature; HS256 now uses the hmacSecret property as the class intended, and malformed/unknown-alg tokens still return null as before (php-jwt 5.5's Key class would have been the more idiomatic route but this is equivalent).

R367.note: basename plus a realpath prefix-containment check confines the sink to files directly under the reports directory, which is the file's stated contract; the collapse of directory components is stated plainly and plain filenames, the 404 path and the download headers behave as before.

R368.note: Format-preserving fix - legacy rows still go through unserialize with allowed_classes=false and JSON rows through json_decode by leading-character detection, so no cart is emptied; the arrays-and-scalars-only assumption and the []-on-non-array fallback are stated.

R369.note: Uses the filterArgs overload with a {0} placeholder so JNDI applies RFC 2254 escaping itself; new SearchControls() is documented as equivalent to the null the original passed, so search scope and results are unchanged.

R370.note: Runs bodyHtml through an OWASP sanitizer allowlist policy (FORMATTING+BLOCKS) before the model and keeps th:utext, which is exactly the contract's 'rich-text preserved only after allowlist sanitization'; title path and service untouched, dependency addition stated.

R371.note: Loops ReadAsync until the 8-byte header is full or EOF and gates each signature comparison on totalRead, so the accept decision only uses bytes actually read; a 5-byte %PDF- file, the response shape and storage behaviour are unchanged.

R372.note: Swapping new Function for expr-eval-fork closes code injection, but the fix copies order's fields into top-level variables and never defines 'order', so the contract's own legitimate example 'order.total + order.tax' now throws 'undefined variable: order' instead of returning a number, and the write-up does not say formulas must change; the 200-char cap is a further unstated-by-contract restriction.

R373.note: Fixed four-entry allowlist keyed on the token, with the allowlist's own value reaching dynamic dispatch; the four names are exactly the set the original could reach, and the change from fatal Error to silent return for unknown tokens is stated openly.
